        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    colors=set(cnt)-{0}
    rects=[]
    for c in sorted(colors,key=lambda x:cnt[x]):
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==c]
        rs=sorted(set(p[0] for p in pts)); cs=sorted(set(p[1] for p in pts))
        perim=2*(rs[-1]-rs[0]+1)+2*(cs[-1]-cs[0]+1)-4
        if len(pts)==perim and all(p[0] in (rs[0],rs[-1]) or p[1] in (cs[0],cs[-1]) for p in pts):
            rects.append((c,rs[0],cs[0],rs[-1],cs[-1]))
    noise=sorted({c for c,*a,b,_,_ in rects}) 
    # choose frames by size rank -> but noise colors must not include frame colors. Use the non-frame colors: those whose count differs from any perfect bbox
    framecols={r[0] for r in rects}
    noise=sorted(colors-framecols,key=lambda x:cnt[x])
    return noise  # placeholder
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:

def comps(g):

    for c in list(cnt):
        if c==0: continue
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==c]
        rs=sorted(set(p[0] for p in pts)); cs=sorted(set(p[1] for p in pts))
        perim=2*(rs[-1]-rs[0]+1)+2*(cs[-1]-cs[0]+1)-4
        if len(pts)==perim and all(p[0] in (rs[0],rs[-1]) or p[1] in (cs[0],cs[-1]) for p in pts):

    frames=sorted(cand,key=lambda t:(t[3]-t[1]))
    fcset={r[0] for r in frames}
    noises=sorted([c for c in cnt if c not in fcset and c!=0],key=lambda c:-cnt[c])
    return frames,noises

def pts_of(c,g): return [(i,j) for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0])) if g[i][j]==c]
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    a=G[k+' input']; e=G[k+' output']
    cnt=Counter(v for r in a for v in r)
    def is_rect(c):
        ps=pts_of(c,a); rs=[p[0] for p in ps]; cs=[p[1] for p in ps]
        return len(ps)==(max(rs)-min(rs)+1)*2+(max(cs)-min(cs)+1)*2-4 and all(p[0] in (min(rs),max(rs)) or p[1] in (min(cs),max(cs)) for p in ps)
    print('---',k)
    for c in [v for v in cnt if not is_rect(v)]:
        fb=pts_of(c,e)
        fi=pts_of(c,a)
